codeReview.summary: The landing page and restaurants index were successfully migrated onto the guest design system, but the feature still falls short of its restaurant detail expectation in the live surface: the canonical /restaurants/[slug] route was not proven against a stable public fixture and the implementation/test coverage remains limited to mocked detail rendering. Because the feature description explicitly includes aligning /restaurants/[slug] with the same shell and component language, this gap is blocking.

issues.description: The updated coverage only verifies the restaurant detail page through a mocked `getRestaurantBySlug` result, while the worker's own browser evidence shows `http://localhost:3000/restaurants/the-fox` resolves to a guest handoff/not-found state instead of the intended detail surface. That means the feature did not actually demonstrate that `/restaurants/[slug]` is aligned with the guest design system in the live runtime, leaving one of the feature's required surfaces unresolved.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The `guest-ui-worker` skill tells workers to use the live browser on localhost:3000, but it does not mention that some features may lack a stable public restaurant slug in local data. This worker spent manual verification effort on `/restaurants/the-fox`, then documented that the runtime fell into a guest handoff/not-found state despite tests passing with mocked data.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Skill: .factory/skills/guest-ui-worker/SKILL.md; Handoff interactiveChecks/discoveredIssues in .factory/missions/7b467445-b8da-4b80-8252-ffa00b1ed7eb/handoffs/2026-03-25T09-47-40-588Z__landing-and-discovery-surfaces__7cb4f231-ae64-47af-85f1-4040d9cb1b89.json lines 61-77 describe the missing live detail fixture.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The mission shared library does not record whether any stable public restaurant slug exists for browser validation on port 3000, even though multiple E2E specs assume `the-fox` is available. That gap forces workers to rediscover at runtime whether discovery/detail routes can be exercised live or only through mocked/unit coverage.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: .factory/library/user-testing.md is present, but the library listing has no dedicated restaurant-fixture note; meanwhile tests/e2e/guest-public-marketing.spec.ts:4 and tests/e2e/guest-booking.spec.ts:3 hard-code `the-fox`, while the handoff reports `http://localhost:3000/restaurants/the-fox` landing on a guest handoff/not-found state.

summary: Reviewed commit 95297b2e, the worker transcript skeleton, mission policy files, and the feature handoff. The landing page and restaurants index improvements look consistent, but the feature should fail scrutiny because `/restaurants/[slug]` was not validated on a stable live public fixture—the worker's own browser evidence shows the expected detail route still falls into a guest handoff/not-found state, and only mocked tests cover the detail shell.
